rules.rule: Unverifiable claims, commands, versions, numbers are gaps: ask, then mark; never invented
must: you cannot verify from\s+the repo or the user is a gap: ask, and if still unknown mark it

rules.rule: A claim the README merely makes and cannot support is deleted, not TODO-marked
A gap in the repo (no license, CI, remote) goes in the reply, not the README
must: goes in the reply and nowhere else

rules.rule: Run every install and quickstart command shipped; never ship one not run
must: Run every install and quickstart command you ship
never ship\s+one you did not run

rules.rule: A command this environment cannot run is reported in the reply; the README is not warned about the sandbox
must: Say so in the reply and leave\s+the README alone
never warn the reader about your sandbox

rules.rule: A command failing for a project reason gets a visible NOTE for the reader, not an invisible TODO
must: use a\s+`> \[!NOTE\]` naming what has to happen first

rules.rule: Numbers called measured are re-measured against the final file
must: measured against what the file\s+finally ships

rules.rule: Writing Go Example files needs its own yes, asked before any .go file is written; a no is honoured
must: it gets its own yes — the approval covering the README does not reach\s+it
never write the file and\s+mention it afterwards

rules.rule: Improve mode reports findings only and edits nothing until approved
must: No edits until the user approves the findings

rules.rule: Create mode asks the gaps in one batch and stops; drafts only after answers
must: ask in one\s+batched round, a numbered list, then stop: draft only once the user has\s+answered

rules.rule: The README is written to file, not pasted into chat
must: do not paste it back into chat
